📢 Fully Funded PhD - Ireland 🇮🇪
RCSI University of Medicine and Health Sciences | Precision Oncology Ireland

Role: PhD Position - Precision Oncology Ireland-02
Title: "Functional precision medicine approaches to guide targeted treatments in T-cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia"
Lab: Targeted Therapeutics Lab | Supervisor: Tríona Ní Chonghaile
Duration: 4 years
Stipend: €25,000 per year
Start: October 2026
Location: Dublin, Ireland

Focus: Investigate novel therapeutic strategies for childhood T-cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia. Use functional precision medicine to identify more effective + less toxic treatments. Techniques: super-resolution imaging, metabolic profiling, apoptotic profiling.
Collaboration: Systems Biology Ireland, CHI at Crumlin, St. James's Hospital/TCD, MAGIC-I study

Minimum: Upper Second Class (2.1) honours degree in Health, Science or Biomedical Science. IELTS/equivalent if non-native English.
Desirable: MSc in Cancer Biology. Lab experience in cell/molecular biology, cancer research.

Deadline: 17 August 2026
Apply: Via RCSI application portal
